raw_result.task_text: I overslept and have to leave for work in 10 minutes. Pack something quick to eat and put it in the living room so I can grab it on my way out, and also gather the things I need for work and put them in the living room.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a quick snack by slicing and pouring any necessary ingredients, then pass it to R2.

central_instructions.R3: Receive the snack from R2 and place it in an accessible spot in the living room.
central_instructions.R4: Gather all necessary work items from around the house and place them in the living room.

llm_judge.TF_reason: The snack preparation goal is partially achieved using real objects (bread, apple, plate), but the work items goal fails because the robots attempt to gather hallucinated objects ('documents', 'charger') from a hallucinated room ('office'/'home office') instead of using the actual Laptop and KeyChain in the living room.
llm_judge.GF_reason: Severe grounding violations. The plan includes multiple hallucinated objects ('granola bar', 'documents', 'charger') and hallucinated rooms ('office', 'home office'). It also uses vague expressions ('Gather work items', 'find a quick snack') and assumes robots can hold multiple items simultaneously without proper manipulation steps.
llm_judge.SC_reason: Critical sequential violations. There are duplicate step IDs (e.g., r1_s1, r1_s2, r3_s2 used multiple times). R1 teleports from the kitchen to a hallucinated 'office' within the same time block. R4 also exhibits disjointed movement and object handling.
llm_judge.CQ_reason: Collaboration is highly redundant and inefficient. R1, R3, and R4 all attempt to gather work items simultaneously. The transfer of the snack involves an unnecessary bucket brigade (R1 to R2 to R3) instead of a single robot simply carrying it to the living room.
